LanguageData.LawAndOrder_SelectCriminal: Select a criminal to view details
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_NoCourtroom: Cannot schedule hearing: No courtroom available. Build a courtroom to proceed.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Pardoned: {0} has been pardoned of all crimes
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_ArmedTrespassing_Des: Base debt for participating in a raid against the colony.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_ArsonBase_Desc: Base debt for using fire as a weapon. Additional cost is added for destroyed items.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_TheftMultiplier_Desc: Multiplier applied to stolen item value. Default 1.5x means debt is 150% of item value.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_ContrabandPerDrug_De: Debt per illegal drug found on the raider (flake, yayo, go-juice).
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_Assault_Desc: Debt for injuring a colonist during combat.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_DownedColonist_Desc: Debt for downing a colonist in combat (more serious than assault).
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_AssaultAnimal_Desc: Debt for harming a colony animal.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_KillAnimalMultiplier: Multiplier applied to animal market value when killed.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_KillBondedAnimalMult: Multiplier applied to bonded animal value (higher due to emotional impact).
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_KillBondedAnimalBonu: Additional flat debt added for killing a bonded animal.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_Murder_Desc: Debt for killing a colonist. Set high to represent a "life sentence" in labor terms.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_PropertyDestructionM: Multiplier applied to destroyed item value. Includes cost of labor to rebuild.
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_BannedWeaponModifier: Multiplier applied to total debt if raider used a banned weapon (e.g., incendiary launcher).
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_RepeatOffenderModifi: Multiplier applied to total debt for repeat offenders (captured multiple times).
LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Setting_DefaultSilverPerDay_: Average silver value produced by a prisoner per day of labor. Used to estimate sentence length.
